notes.title: New update 3.0
notes.content:
Hola, here is the new update.  I wanted to add it for a long time. There are some new interesting places some fixed bugs... But you'll figure it out. Thank you for playing and helping me improve this project. Good luck. Here is the video where you can see some of the environments.

notes.title: Wizard 2.0 build
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36912194/388a538f6b7184cf384a9fa62e9b45354a1e55f4.png[/img]here is one video from live game developement streams. There are more than 1000 of them at our YT channel. 

[previewyoutube=qmzRJdCkNzs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

What is fixed: 

- new achievements

- trello link where you can find info about updates and plans 
https://trello.com/b/psj20KJh/wizard-project

-splash screens at level openings

-music in the first part of the third level

-character standing under the ground level 5

-small improvement in game optimization of the level 5

-mouse lag improvements

- disabled mouse smoothing

- disabled FOVScaling  and more...

-misleading teleport in the first level.

- new level art

One tip for the end : Did you know that you can fight with your sword in the first level?

Ok, you'll find the way I hope.
